_about: US rental figures for a budget in dollars (BUDGET-USD, 21 Oct 2026). Read by src/lib/budget-model.js and shown on budget.html only when the budget is in US dollars, where the Chennai card is shown for a rupee budget. RULES FOR EDITING: every row carries the vendor's own published prices, the page they came from and the day they were read; the per-day band is DERIVED from those prices (the 7-day price over 7 days is the low end, the 3-day price over 3 days the high end), never typed. These are ONE mail-order rental house's list prices for the kit it names, without damage coverage, tax or shipping. They are not union rates, not a market survey and not a quote. No inflation multiplier is applied. An item with no sourced figure has no row and the page shows nothing for it rather than an invented number. Crew day rates have no row at all: we found no published US figure we could cite without quoting a union agreement, so none is offered.
